name: New Mexico
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (federal ADA Title II floor only)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: NM Legislature HB 295 (2026) — proposed digital accessibility act (not enacted)

applies_to: State agencies and local governments via ADA Title II; no state CIO rule or statute setting a web standard found.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

mobile: not addressed — no state instrument found; federal rule covers mobile apps.
procurement: No state accessibility procurement requirement found.
enforcement: ADA Title II; agency-level ADA grievance procedures (e.g., DoIT ADA coordinator).
notes: The brief expected 'state CIO rules'; none found (NMAC/DoIT searches returned nothing on web accessibility). HB 295 (2026) would have required WCAG 2.1 AA by 2027-04-01, statements, and an Office of Accessibility; it passed the House 57-6 but was postponed indefinitely in the Senate. HB 120 (2025) was a similar bill; status not confirmed. Governor's Commission on Disability used as office URL (no dedicated state digital accessibility office found).
